sources.provider: Purdue Weldon School of Biomedical Engineering building information
sources.method: Used the page statement that the building has three stories and a basement, the address 206 S. Martin Jischke Drive, and the listed west/east public entrances and north service entrance.
sources.uncertainty: Page does not provide exterior elevations or measured heights.

sources.feature_id: Purdue-published photo attached to MJIS place page
sources.method: Visual evidence for three-level massing, glazed upper central facade, brick lower facade, pale opaque end masses, and recessed entrance. Raw page and image are saved in sources/.
sources.uncertainty: Single oblique photo shows one corner only; it cannot establish all sides, dimensions, or exact facade bay spacing.

geometry.height_status: estimated; three floors per official BME page, no measured elevation available
geometry.roof: flat low-slope roof modeled from GIS footprint; height and parapet are estimates
geometry.edits: Replace imported massing mesh with an 88-vertex generalized version of the 178-vertex official GIS ring (0.45 m local simplification tolerance; maximum original source vertex deviation 1.02 m), a three-level shell, brick lower band, pale end walls, upper window bays, two schematic public-entrance markers on west/east sides, and restrained roof parapet. Keep the existing object, collection, asset path, campus coordinate frame, and campus placement.

validation.reopen_report: validation.json; saved Blender library reopened in Blender 5.2.3, expected one mesh in exported collection, 6,482 evaluated vertices and 4,402 evaluated faces, no external image or library paths, XY campus bounds compared against GIS polygon; vertical bounds 0 to 14.2 m (estimated)
validation.uncertainty: The independent grade identified the broad upper curtain wall as under-modeled; entrance markers are schematic rather than surveyed door locations. Upper window spacing and facade dimensions are estimates from one oblique photo. Height and roof dimensions remain estimated; the source GIS footprint is not survey-grade.
